related_questions.question: How long are you immune to COVID after having it?

text_blocks.snippet: Immunity to COVID-19 after an infection typically lasts for 3-4 months. While natural immunity provides some protection, it's not as robust or long-lasting as immunity gained from vaccination. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) recommends vaccination even after a COVID-19 infection, especially for those who haven't had the latest booster.

list.title: Evolving Variants:
list.snippet: As new variants emerge, natural immunity from previous infections may not offer adequate protection against newer strains.

list.title: Vaccination Benefits:
list.snippet: Vaccines are still highly effective in preventing severe illness, hospitalization, and death, even if they don't always prevent infection.

list.title: Boosters:
